datasheet_id_and_revision: SLOSEE6 - July 2026, initial release (revision '*', p16 revision history). Package option addendum dated 22-Jul-2026; legal notice last updated 10/2025.
datasheet_status: Advance information. A vertical 'ADVANCE INFORMATION' banner is printed on every datasheet page (pp1-17) and the p1 footer reads 'ADVANCE INFORMATION for preproduction products; subject to change without notice.' The only orderable, XOPA955DSGR, is listed as status Active, material type 'Preproduction' (prototype/experimental, not released for full production, sold without warranties, purchase needs a waiver; p18). RoHS '-', lead finish and MSL 'Call TI'.
preliminary_values: The whole document is advance information, so every specification (all EC table values, all typical curves, package data) is preliminary. No individual parameter carries a separate 'preliminary' or 'design target' marking, and no value is labelled as simulated. Values that look copied from the OPA855 datasheet (identical numbers): thermal metrics (Table 6.4), offset-voltage limits, I_B drift (-0.08 uA/C), I_OS drift (1 nA/C), output swing limits, ESD, power-supply ranges, CM input resistance (2.3 Mohm).
source_conventions: pdf_page = 1-based PDF index; printed_page equals pdf_page for pdf pages 1-17; p18 = package option addendum, p19 = generic package view, p20 = legal notice. EC = Section 6.5 at VS+ = 5 V, VS- = 0 V, G = 7 V/V, RF = 453 ohm, input CM at midsupply, RL = 200 ohm to midsupply, TA = 25 C. TC = Section 6.6 header: TA = 25 C, VS+ = 2.5 V, VS- = -2.5 V, VIN+ = 0 V, RF = 453 ohm, G = 7 V/V, RL = 200 ohm to midsupply. Types as in OPA855.json (TYP, MIN/MAX at 25 C, CURVE, DERIVED, TEXT). The EC table has no MIN/MAX over temperature.
curve_extraction_method: Figs 6-6 and 6-7 read from PDF vector paths (scripts_archive/extraction/pdf_vector_curves.py with ids selected by scripts_archive/extraction/vector_ids_by_style.py); other plots digitized from 600-dpi renders with scripts_archive/extraction/raster_curve_digitizer.py.

min_stable_gain.below_min_gain: Only p9 Section 7: inverting -7 V/V with 50-ohm matched termination gives noise gain 5.3 V/V, 'lower than the recommended +7 V/V', and 5 dB peaking (Fig 6-1). No further guidance on operation below the minimum gain and no TIA compensation section (Section 9 contains only power-supply and layout subsections). Eq. 1 (p15): noise gain = 1 + Z_F/Z_IN. DERIVED from Fig 6-6: A_OL = 16.9 dB at about 1.44 GHz where phase is about -140 deg, i.e. roughly 40 deg phase margin at noise gain 7 (not stated in the datasheet); phase reaches -180 deg at about 2.9 GHz where A_OL is about 10.1 dB (3.2 V/V).

packages.ep_connection: Table 5-1 (p3): 'connect to a heat-spreading power or ground plane'; Section 8.4.1 (p12): negative supply for split supply, ground for single supply; Fig 9-2 (p14): 'connect the thermal pad to the negative supply pin'
packages.notes: Only the generic package view (p19, drawing 4224783/A) is included; no outline, land-pattern or stencil drawing in this revision. Orderable XOPA955DSGR, 3000 per large reel, preproduction (p18). Thermal metrics identical to OPA855.

pinout_notes: Same as OPA855: 1 FB (internally connected to output), 2 NC (must be left floating; isolates FB from IN-), 3 IN-, 4 IN+, 5 VS-, 6 OUT, 7 VS+, 8 PD (low = off, high = on), thermal pad. R_F between FB and IN- on the same package side (Fig 8-4, p11). Source p3, p11.

tia_content.what: Front-page 'Transimpedance Bandwidth vs Frequency' (normalized transimpedance gain, dBohm)
tia_content.C_D_or_source_C: C_IN = 4.7 pF (whether amplifier input C is included is not stated); I_IN = 20 uApp
tia_content.bandwidth: -3 dB at about 112 MHz (CURVE, +/-3 MHz); no peaking; -0.5 dB at 50 MHz, -2.4 dB at 100 MHz, -8.8 dB at 200 MHz, -14.9 dB at 300 MHz

tia_content.C_D_or_source_C: C_IN = 4.7 pF; I_IN = 100 uA pulse (input edge speed not stated)
tia_content.bandwidth: output step about 1.03 V; 10-90 % rise about 3.1 ns, 90-10 % fall about 3.0 ns, 50 % width about 9.8 ns, about 20 mV (2 %) undershoot after the pulse; 10 ns/div, 250 mV/div

tia_content.C_F: if required C_F < 0.15 pF use two series resistors of R_F/2
tia_content.bandwidth: Eq. 1 (p15): noise gain = 1 + Z_F/Z_IN; R_ISO 10-20 ohm at IN- for APD trace inductance

application_guidance: Layout (p14-p15): minimise parasitic C on output and IN- (cut planes under signal pins); decoupling within 0.25 in; surface-mount resistors; for TIA with C_F < 0.15 pF split R_F into two series halves; keep APD close and on the same PCB side; R_ISO 10-20 ohm close to IN-; close the R_F/C_F/R_ISO loop at the APD pins; connect PD to VS+ to enable (Fig 9-2). Bias-cancellation resistor on IN+ can be bypassed with 1 uF in inverting use (p10). Typical applications (p1): OTDR, ToF LiDAR, SiPM buffer, PMT post amplifier; companion parts TDC7201, LMH13000, THS4541, LMH5401.
abs_max_and_input_protection: VS 5.5 V; V_IN (VS-) - 0.5 V to (VS+) + 0.5 V; differential input 1 V; continuous input current +/-10 mA; continuous output current +/-50 mA; TJ 150 C; TA -40..125 C; Tstg -65..150 C (p4). ESD HBM +/-1500 V, CDM +/-1500 V (p4). ESD diodes to both supplies and two anti-parallel diodes between the inputs (p11 Fig 8-3).
other_notes: Power down (p6): disable threshold 0.65 min / 0.95 typ V ('amplifier OFF below this voltage'); enable threshold 1 typ / 1.8 max V ('ON above'); reference node not stated for OPA955; PD bias current 30 typ / 50 max uA; turn-on 120 ns, turn-off 30 ns; power-down supply current 465 / 520 uA.
Section 7 (p9): gains +20 and +40 V/V use RF = 909 ohm.

Inconsistencies: (1) A_OL table 76 dB typ vs about 87 dB on Fig 6-6; (2) current noise 0.55 pA/rtHz is below full shot noise of the 2 uA typical bias current (sqrt(2 q I_B) = 0.80 pA/rtHz), unusual for a bipolar input (one of the two numbers may be wrong or preliminary); (3) Fig 6-6 phase starts at +12 deg at 100 kHz; (4) Fig 6-1 G = -7 peaking reads about 4 dB vs '5 dB' in text p9; (5) thermal-pad connection worded differently in Table 5-1 vs Section 8.4.1 / Fig 9-2; (6) thermal table and several DC numbers identical to OPA855; (7) V_IL at 3.3 V supply typ 0.9 V (lower than 1.1 V at 5 V) but max 1.4 V (higher than 1.35 V); (8) typos 'Bandwdith', 'respone', symbol e_i for current noise.
No open-loop output impedance, CMRR/PSRR vs frequency, distortion, transient, swing-vs-current or capacitive-load plots in this revision (Section 6.6 has only Figs 6-1 to 6-7).
